The following lemma is here just to point out set theoretical difficulties
do indeed arise and should be ignored by most readers.

Let <MATH_0001> be a nonzero ring. There does not exist a set <MATH_0002> of
fpqc-coverings of <MATH_0003> such that every fpqc-covering can
